name: Cuspera

sources.title: Vendor page — 'Listing on Cuspera and traffic will always be FREE'; List Software is a Google Form; banner says 'we are in beta and unable to process all requests'

conditions: Free listing is offered ('always be FREE') but the site states it is 'in beta and unable to process all the requests' — submissions go into a queue they resume later
First check whether your software is already listed (AI-curated profiles are auto-generated from reviews/blogs/customer stories)
requirements: B2B/business software — Cuspera matches software to business teams' needs via AI
Submission is via an external Google Form (linked 'LIST SOFTWARE' button)
Enrichment path: submit industry use-cases, case studies, testimonials via a second Google Form ('Submit your customer proof points')
preparation: Software name, website, company details for the Google Form
Case studies and customer testimonials as 'proof points' — the AI recommends on these, not keyword categories
Google account may be needed to fill the form
workflow: Use the 'Check whether your software is already listed' search first — claim/update via 'UPDATE YOUR LISTING' form if present
If not listed, click 'LIST SOFTWARE' → Google Form submission
Submit customer proof points (case studies/testimonials) via the second form to improve matching
Wait — beta notice says they respond once request processing resumes
watchFor: Beta hold: 'unable to process all the requests' — timeline for listing is undefined
Forms are Google Forms — external dependency, fields may change
Upsell context: they also sell an AI advisor widget for your site (demo-request lead gen) — expect a sales follow-up
Profiles are AI-generated 360° pages — check accuracy of any auto-created listing
countsAsLive: The software has a public profile page on cuspera.com/products (or appears in category Buyer's Guides and search)
unknowns: When beta processing will resume / real turnaround
Whether 'always free' listing has stayed true post-beta
